description:
Identify scenic roads by performing a spatial selection. Load the global roads and parks datasets, then extract all road segments that intersect with parks or protected lands.

1. Open QGIS.
2. Load the Roads shapefile from `/home/ga/GIS_Data/natural_earth/ne_10m_roads.shp`.
3. Load the Parks shapefile from `/home/ga/GIS_Data/natural_earth/ne_10m_parks_and_protected_lands.shp`.
4. Use the 'Extract by location' processing tool (Vector Selection > Extract by location).
5. Configure to extract features from 'ne_10m_roads' that 'intersect' with features from 'ne_10m_parks_and_protected_lands'.
6. Save the Extracted features as a GeoJSON file to `/home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/scenic_roads.geojson`.
